Message:
I was chasing after Solomon,
who was trying to flee.

Solomon is the acolyte of
the most ancient demon.

If he had the ability to
reawaken the Curse of poison,
then he should be able to dispel it.
If Solomon did that,
then the Hero would...
“I have been waiting for you.”

Solomon halted in his tracks
and turned back towards me.

“The angel has lied to you.
The Hero of the Staff will
indeed be killed.”

...Liar. There’s no way
that could be true.

...That I knew, but the instant
I recalled the Hero’s spirit
being cast in shadow,
a crack formed in my heart.

A crack so slight, it would be easy
to say nothing was even there.

That was where
Solomon targeted.

“The dead do not come back.
However, the laws of God
can be defied.
By the one with
the power to touch and
manipulate spirits—you.”

That was the ultimate taboo.
To trifle with spirits is
beyond unforgivable.

Yet, as unforgivable as it was,
I couldn’t help but listen to
Solomon’s silver tongue.

His noxious allure, which could
enchant even the likes of God,
whispered sweetly into my heart.

If you freeze now and
refuse to lift even a finger,
the Hero is sure to die...

Stop...! Don’t you tamper
with my heart...!

Everything, even the thoughts
I’ve buried deep inside,
will be ripped out and
twisted as you please.

That’s not something
a human would do...!

The realization that this
was the power of a demon
sent my body trembling.
Yes—my body was
trembling with fear.
“Only I...can save...”

No, that’s not right.
My body...was beginning
to tremble...with delight.
